info.description:
### Overview

[Aperture](https://tailscale.com/docs/features/aperture) is a centralized AI gateway that runs inside your tailnet. It manages access to LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google — using [Tailscale identity](https://tailscale.com/docs/features/aperture#identity-through-tailscale) instead of distributing API keys.

This API allows you to manage your Aperture instance programmatically.

### Base URL

The API is served at the `/aperture` path prefix on your Aperture node's tailnet address. By default this is `http://ai/aperture` (MagicDNS) or `http://ai.your-tailnet.ts.net/aperture` (full domain). The hostname depends on how Aperture is configured on your tailnet.

The OpenAPI spec is available at [/aperture/openapi.json](/aperture/openapi.json).

### Authentication

All requests are authenticated using your [Tailscale identity](https://tailscale.com/docs/concepts/tailscale-identity). No API keys are required.

Aperture has two roles: **admin** and **user**. Roles are assigned through grants in the Aperture configuration or via Tailscale ACL grants. Each endpoint documents which role is required.

### Errors

Errors follow [RFC 9457](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9457) Problem Details. Validation errors (422) include an `errors` array with per-field details.

get.description:
Returns the current Aperture instance configuration as a [HuJSON](https://github.com/tailscale/hujson) string. API keys in provider blocks are redacted.

The response includes an `ETag` header. Pass it as `If-Match` when updating the configuration to prevent concurrent overwrites.

Requires the **admin** role.

schema.description: Opaque version identifier for the current configuration

put.description:
Replaces the entire Aperture instance configuration. The request body must contain the full configuration as a [HuJSON](https://github.com/tailscale/hujson) string.

You must include the `If-Match` header with the `ETag` from a previous GET to prevent concurrent overwrites. If the configuration has changed since your last GET, the server returns `412 Precondition Failed`.

The configuration is validated before saving. If validation fails, the server returns `422 Unprocessable Entity` with details.

Requires the **admin** role.

parameters.description: ETag from a previous GET, used to prevent concurrent overwrites
parameters.name: If-Match

schema.description: ETag from a previous GET, used to prevent concurrent overwrites
Opaque version identifier for the saved configuration

post.description:
Validates a [HuJSON](https://github.com/tailscale/hujson) configuration without saving it. Use this to check for errors before committing changes with PUT.

Returns validation errors, if any.

Requires the **admin** role.

get.description:
Returns the complete pricing catalog as a formatted [HuJSON](https://github.com/tailscale/hujson) document. The catalog includes every known model string resolved under every supported cost basis, plus this instance's configured `model_cost_map` rules. Token prices are displayed in USD per 1 million tokens; the document's `units` object declares the basis and quantity for every pricing field. Model access grants do not filter the response.

Requires an explicit `read_pricing: true` grant; the admin role alone is not sufficient.

Requires an explicit `read_pricing: true` grant; the admin role alone is not sufficient.
